async function save(x) {}

// CASE regex_semicolon_in_header expect=fire
async function h1(items) {
	for (let i = 0, re = /;/g; i < items.length; i++) {
		await save(items[i].replace(re, ""));
	}
}

// CASE comment_in_header expect=fire
async function h2(items) {
	for (let i = 0 /* start */, n = items.length; i < n; i++) {
		await save(items[i]);
	}
}

// CASE string_semicolon_header expect=fire
async function h3(items) {
	for (let i = 0, sep = ";"; i < items.length; i++) {
		await save(items[i] + sep);
	}
}

// CASE template_in_header expect=fire
async function h4(items) {
	for (let i = 0, tag = `a;${items.length}`; i < items.length; i++) {
		await save(tag);
	}
}
